categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Longood Intelligent Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: intelligent controllers, new energy, and intelligent terminal products. The intelligent controller segment includes smart controllers and motor application products serving downstream industries such as power tools, home appliances, automotive electronics, robotics, and emerging fields. The new energy segment covers lithium battery packs, battery management systems (BMS), and energy storage inverters. The intelligent terminal products segment includes new consumer appliances, smart pet products, and smart lighting applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies revolve around chip applications centered on microcontrollers (MCU) and digital signal processors (DSP), integrating intelligent control, motor technology, and battery management software and hardware. It develops brushless DC motors (BLDC) with advantages in efficiency, stability, noise reduction, and lifespan. Production follows a make-to-order model with flexible manufacturing, supported by in-house developed automated testing systems and AI-driven digital transformation to enhance efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large, reputable manufacturers in power tools, home appliances, automotive electronics, robotics, and new energy sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales to overseas customers. Its products are highly customized to meet diverse application scenarios demanded by downstream industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D bases in Shenzhen, Guangdong, Anhui, Zhejiang, and overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam. It has expanded manufacturing capacity in Southeast Asia, particularly in Vietnam, to serve international markets and mitigate trade risks. Sales are divided between domestic and foreign markets, with over 55% of revenue from overseas regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longood occupies a midstream position in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of intelligent controllers and related components. It sources upstream raw materials such as semiconductors, PCBs, and electronic components, mostly domestically sourced with some high-end imports. The company supplies critical components to downstream manufacturers of end products in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent control, motor technology, and battery management systems, investing about 5.68% of revenue in R&D. It focuses on developing new applications in emerging fields like automotive electronics, robotics, and smart terminals. Strategic priorities include enhancing product integration, expanding overseas production capacity, adopting AI and IoT technologies, and upgrading manufacturing automation to improve competitiveness and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized intelligent controllers, new energy products, and intelligent terminal devices. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, signing supply framework agreements with major customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and confirmation of product acceptance, including export sales settled mainly in USD and HKD.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longood is positioned as a leading domestic player in the intelligent control sector, competing with established international brands primarily from Germany and the UK. The company benefits from increasing domestic market share due to improved technology and supply chain capabilities, capitalizing on the trend of industry localization and substitution of imported products. It maintains competitive advantages through strong R&D, quality control, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.62 billion, a 21.67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.7 million, up 29.2%. The company has shown steady growth driven by downstream market recovery and new business expansion. Total assets reached RMB 2.19 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. Despite positive growth, operating cash flow was negative due to increased working capital requirements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longood differentiates itself through its comprehensive intelligent control technology, integrating MCU/DSP-based software and hardware solutions tailored to diverse customer needs. Its proprietary brushless motor technology offers superior efficiency and durability. The company emphasizes rapid market responsiveness, flexible production, and stringent quality control systems certified to international standards. It also leverages AI and digital transformation to enhance product innovation and manufacturing efficiency, providing high-value, customized solutions that support customers’ intelligent product upgrades.
